verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe request-level gateway features (fallbacks, retries, caching, load balancing) and per-key budget/rate-limit controls, but there is no evidence of an actual bulk-operations capability — e.g., batch APIs, bulk-edit of configs/keys/prompts, multi-select actions in the UI, or CSV import/export across many items at once. missing for 10: any documented batch/bulk API, bulk config or prompt management tooling, or UI bulk-action support.
